fact: The IACA journal case study states that before the IECMS case tracking was manual and paper-based with no e-filing, and that phases went live on 1 May 2022 (superior courts, Commercial Division) and 1 February 2023 (Labour and Administrative Courts).
title: Best Practices and Approaches to Judicial Digital Transformation: Zimbabwe IECMS Case Study
publisher: The Court Administrator (International Association for Court Administration)
